question:
By Interchanging the given two numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

3 and 7
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4dca46f39a84a1663618a430e087d88ac10e3c3e2017cdea8d45b1b476b9b3e9.png] 

Given numbers: 3 and 7

1) 7 × 8 - 3 + 2 = 19

After interchange the numbers we get:

= __**3 × 8**__ - 7 + 2 = 19

= __**24 - 7 + 2**__ = 19

= 19 = 19
